concerns.text: FR-001 and FR-002 require real ACE/WIND composition CDF files. The implementation plan (plan.md) states that, due to lack of an open dataset, the pipeline will generate a deterministic synthetic dataset instead. T003 still claims to download real data, so the functional requirements are weakened unless a constitution amendment (Principle VI) is approved and a gating task is added.

T012’s final report hard‑codes `source_type: "Real"` even when the pipeline may run on synthetic data pending amendment. This misrepresents the data provenance and violates Constitution Principle VI (Composition Data Integrity) as well as the spec’s requirement to accurately reflect data source.

SC-001 stipulates that a claim of statistical significance is only made when ΔR² > 0.05; otherwise a “statistically significant but below practical threshold” message must be reported. No task enforces this conditional logic, so the specification’s success criterion is weakened.
T001 pins `requirements.txt` but is not linked to any functional requirement or acceptance criterion in the spec, making it an orphan task that does not contribute to any FR/SC.

FR-003 requires that the aligned dataset contain exactly one row per hour with **no missing values in core index columns**. T004’s verification mentions core columns must be non‑missing, but does not explicitly verify that *every* hour in the study period is present (including handling of leap seconds or daylight‑saving anomalies). This leaves a potential gap in meeting FR‑003.

The final report must include a disclaimer when only synthetic data are used (as required by the amendment dependency in the plan). T012 does not specify generation of such a disclaimer, risking a silent violation of Constitution Principle VI.
